title: Cookies and Session Authentication
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of cookies and session authentication in a FastAPI application.
Apply or interpret one example related to cookie-based authentication concepts.
Identify one limitation or failure case and describe how to verify it.

content.intro: This lesson covers cookies and session authentication within authentication and authorization. Use the supplied syllabus topics as the coverage checklist, then connect them to the worked example and the verification task.
content.why_it_matters: You will use cookies and session authentication to build APIs whose contracts and behavior are understandable to both clients and maintainers. The practical aim is security boundaries, identity verification, least privilege and verifiable authorization decisions.

content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: Cookies and Session Authentication matters because it is part of authentication and authorization. In practice, focus on security boundaries, identity verification, least privilege and verifiable authorization decisions. A framework feature only helps when its assumptions match the application; keep input validation, business policy and side effects distinguishable.
